title: Meowdoku!
description:
Looking for a game that soothes the soul but keeps your brain spinning? Welcome to Meowdoku — a pure logic puzzle game that flawlessly blends the rigorous reasoning of Sudoku with the thrilling deduction of Minesweeper.

Here, you have only one mission: find the perfect "exclusive territory" for every aloof little cat!
Simple Rules, Deep Strategy

The concept is elegant and intuitive, yet anything but simple:
• Exclusive Territory: The board is divided into colored sections. You must place exactly one cat in each section.
• The Aloof Rule: Cats need absolute personal space! They absolutely cannot share the same row, column, or touch each other—not even diagonally.
• Risk & Reward: Double-tap a tile to place a cat. You only have 3 chances to make a mistake (hearts). Guess right, and you're rewarded with pure puzzle-solving satisfaction; guess wrong, and you lose a heart. Guessing won't save you; every single move must be carefully calculated!

Key Features
• Pure & Immersive Experience
• Non-Intrusive Ads: Zero interruptions to your gameplay, letting you fully enjoy a completely focused, Zen-like flow state.
• Play Offline Anytime: No internet required. Perfectly fills up the puzzle-shaped hole in your daily commute, time spent waiting in line, or your morning coffee break.

Wake up your mind with brand-new "Daily Puzzles" every single day.
Push your limits and see if you can break your fastest completion times on the global leaderboards. Why Meowdoku Will Stay on Your Phone Meowdoku won't hijack your attention with tedious social mechanics or endless daily grinds—it earns your love through pure gameplay quality. With its minimalist aesthetic and satisfying tactile feedback, it takes just seconds to learn. Yet, long after you put your phone down, its elegant logic loop will keep lingering in your mind. Ready for a brain-teasing puzzle adventure filled with adorable felines? Download Meowdoku now, put your logic to the test, and become the ultimate feline puzzle master!

ROBLOX – MILLIONS OF GAMES ACROSS EVERY GENRE. PLAY FREE.

Roblox is home to every kind of game, for every kind of player. Compete in high-octane racing games, battle it out in hardcore tactical shooters, or put your survival skills to the test in unpredictable environments. Embark on an epic adventure in immersive RPGs, build massive empires in tycoons, or dive into horror, anime, and sports games with friends worldwide.

Roblox is constantly evolving, with unique experiences and ambitious, high-fidelity games built by a global community including professional studios, indie teams, and solo creators. There’s always something new to discover every day.

Start playing some of the most popular games on Roblox today, including Dress to Impress, RIVALS, Steal a Brainrot, Brookhaven RP, Adopt Me! and more.

WHAT YOU CAN DO ON ROBLOX

PLAY ONLINE MULTIPLAYER GAMES
- Discover deep role-playing games, immersive simulators, action-packed adventures, and more
- Explore trending experiences and new games daily
- Compete in massive multiplayer battles, run your own digital business, or embark on epic quests
- Games may contain optional in-game purchases, including lootboxes and other items

CREATE YOUR OWN AVATAR
- Customize your avatar with detailed clothing, accessories, and dynamic hairstyles
- Discover thousands of user-created 3D avatar items in the Marketplace
- Express yourself with unique emotes, and fashion

CHAT, COMPETE, AND EXPLORE TOGETHER—ANYTIME, ANYWHERE
- Hang out and play with friends in cross-platform multiplayer games on mobile, tablet, PC, console, and VR headsets
- Join a Party and jump into competitive or social experiences together
- Age-verified users can communicate in real-time via voice chat or text

CREATE, PLAY, AND SHARE ON ROBLOX
- Design high-fidelity games and virtual spaces using the Roblox Studio engine on Windows or Mac
- Publish your experiences and empower yourself as a creator in a massive global community
- Dive into immersive 3D multiplayer games and safe, inclusive environments designed for users of all ages
- Enjoy endless new content added daily and share your creations with millions of players

ELEVATE YOUR EXPERIENCE WITH ROBLOX PLUS
- Get up to 20% discounts on in-game items, enjoy fee-free Robux transfers, and receive a distinct profile badge
- Host free, unlimited private servers for your friends 
- Publish, trade, and resell your own custom avatar creations on the Marketplace

INDUSTRY-LEADING SAFETY, PRIVACY, AND CIVILITY
- Advanced content filtering and age-appropriate moderation
- Access age-verified spaces and manage your privacy with Roblox Kids and Select Accounts
- Clear community guidelines promoting respectful interactions
- Dedicated trust & safety teams working around the clock

title: Magic Sort!
description:
Discover Magic Sort! Mix colors in a world where every splash of water is a step into mystery. This isn’t just a game; it’s a journey through puzzles that sparkle with charm, inviting you to sort, match, and puzzle your way through.

Quick Play Guide

- Start Simple: Tap a bottle to pick it up, and another to pour the water. Organize the water so each bottle has only one color.
- Think Ahead: Pour water only if it matches the top color of the destination bottle and there’s room. Plan to avoid dead ends and strategically sort the colors.
- Embrace Complexity: With each level, sorting and matching require more thought. Every move is crucial.
- Utilize Magic Tools: Stuck? Use 'Undo' to reverse moves, or 'Shuffle' to rearrange the bottles anew, making sorting a breeze.

Cool Features

- Spellbinding Levels: Each stage brings a fresh challenge of color sorting and magical fun.
- Wizard’s Gear: Magic tools make your quest of water sorting smoother and way more fun.
- Vivid Splashes: A riot of colors makes every move a delight, turning sorting into a visual feast.
- Unique Twists: Classic puzzles get a magical makeover for extra thrill, blending color, water, and puzzle elements seamlessly.
- Boosts & Surprises: Stir up boosts in the cauldron to power through puzzles, adding a layer of strategy to your color sorting.
- Mystical Ingredients: Gather ingredients to brew stronger magic, enhancing your water sort adventures.

Why Play Magic Sort?

- Sharpen Your Brain: Each puzzle is a fun test of wits, blending elements of color, water, and sorting into each challenge.
- Chill Vibes: Dive into a soothing, colorful escape, where water and color sorting provide a tranquil experience.
- Magic at Every Turn: New potions and surprises make every level an adventure in water, color, and puzzle-solving.

Get Ready to Cast Some Color! 

Download Magic Sort now and start your magical, colorful journey. The world of mystical puzzles, where water, sorting, and color converge, awaits!

4.Play Offline, Anywhere – No Wi-Fi? No problem! Perfect for travel or relaxing at home.
5.Daily Brain Exercises – New puzzles every day to keep your mind sharp!
6.Hints & Undo – Stuck? Use smart tools to solve tough levels stress-free.
7.Optimized for All Devices – Smooth gameplay on iPhone, iPad tablets!

3.Level Up! – Puzzles get trickier as you progress – train your brain!

Perfect For:
1.Seniors & Elderly Players – Easy controls, no time limits, and large visible tiles.

title: Block Blast！
description:
Enter the world of Block Blast, where every move is a test of your brain and strategy. Dive into the thrill of block crush gameplay—watch vibrant cubes explode in color as you solve each puzzle. With fresh daily puzzle challenges that keep your mind engaged and an endless high score system that rewards your best strategies, Block Blast delivers nonstop excitement for casual players and puzzle masters alike.

Why You'll Love Block Blast
• Daily Puzzle Variety: Every day brings a new puzzle twist, ensuring there’s always something fresh to solve and new rewards to earn.
• Block Puzzle Saga: Match colorful blocks on an 8x8 board and enjoy the satisfying cascade of each block crush.
• Endless High Score Hunt: Push yourself further with each game—break your own records, and climb higher every time you play.
• Casual Yet Challenging: Easy to pick up, but packed with logic-based challenges that sharpen your mind.
• Offline Fun: Play anywhere, anytime—no WiFi required. Perfect for a subway ride or while waiting in the car.

Features of Block Blast
• Strategic Puzzle Gameplay: Drag, place, and match cube blocks on board to trigger chain reactions.
• Adventure Mode: Experience progressive levels with unique jigsaw designs and colorful themes.
• Daily Puzzle Rewards: Stay motivated with special challenges that refresh your brain every day.
• Score Mastery: Compete against friends, share your results, and prove who dominates the endless high score.
• Stunning Block Effects: Feel the rush of every block crush with dynamic visuals and relaxing music effects.

How to Play
• Drag & Match: Place cube blocks on the 8x8 board with precision.
• Crush & Score: Complete rows or columns of tiles and watch the block crush effects cascade.
• Chase Combos: Plan your moves to unlock massive points and extend your endless high score run.
• Stay Strategic: Keep your board clear to make room for bigger plays.

Jump into the Ultimate Block Puzzle Saga!
Ready for mind-sharpening fun? Take on fresh daily puzzles, master the art of the block crush, and see how far you can push your endless high score. Download Block Blast today and start your adventure!

title: Township
description:
BUILD YOUR DREAM TOWN!

Welcome to Township, a thrilling city-building and farming game where you become the mayor of your own town!
Build houses, factories, and community buildings, grow crops on your farm, and decorate your town just the way you like. Take part in limited-time events, compete in exciting regattas, and earn exclusive prizes!

Need a break from city planning? Jump into relaxing match-3 puzzles to earn rewards, speed up your progress, and unlock even more fun - all available offline!
Township - the perfect blend of city-building, farming, and match-3 gameplay!

GAME FEATURES:
● Unlimited creativity: Design and build the metropolis of your dreams!
● Engaging match-3 puzzles: Complete fun levels to earn rewards and boost your progress!
● Exciting competitions: Test your skills against players from around the world in regular competitions - win prizes and make unforgettable memories!
● Exclusive collections: Gather valuable artifacts, rare antiquities, and colorful profile pictures to showcase your achievements!
● Offline play: Enjoy Township anytime, anywhere - even without an internet connection!
● Vibrant community: Meet friendly characters with unique personalities!
● Social connections: Play with your Facebook and Game Center friends or make new friends in the Township community!

Why You'll Love Township:
● A unique mix of city-building, farming, and match-3 gameplay!
● Stunning graphics and charming animations
● Regular updates with fresh content and special events
● Personalize your town with a wide variety of decorations

Township is free to play, but some in-game elements (including randomized items) can be purchased for real money. If you don't want to take advantage of this option, simply turn it off in your device's Restrictions menu.

A Wi-Fi or internet connection is not required to play.
*An internet connection is required to access competitions and additional features.

Do you like Township? Follow us!
Facebook: facebook.com/TownshipMobile
Instagram: instagram.com/township_mobile/

Need to report an issue or ask a question? Contact Player Support through the game by going to Settings > Help and Support. If you can't access the game, use the web chat by clicking the chat icon in the lower right corner of our website: https://playrix.helpshift.com/hc/en/3-township/

title: Whiteout Survival
description:
The world's original winter-themed mobile game! Over 400M players!

The blizzard has reset the world, and now, a new story awaits your touch!
As a rising survivor, gather your crew and team up with the free SSR hero Molly.
Together, you'll set out on a joyful adventure, spark the fire of hope, and rebuild a cozy home on the frozen frontier!

[Game Features]
◆Rebuild & Restore: Easy Progress
Warmth begins with a single spark. Fire up the furnace to melt the snow and reclaim the land! Manage your people and resources to build a bustling, welcoming town!

◆Idle & Earn: Constant Rewards
Send your heroes out with one tap, then come back to a pile of resources ready for your next big upgrade, all stress-free.

◆Tap & Play: Instant Fun
Go ice fishing for rare catches or uncover hidden treasures beneath the snow. Perfect for quick, fun sessions anytime!

◆Plan & Pair: Heroic Combos
All heroes share the same level, so you can upgrade and swap without the grind. Mix and match their skills for ultimate combos!

◆Unite & Triumph: Shared Success
Join an alliance to heal faster, grow stronger, and explore further. Together, we share the chill and the cheer!

Ready to thrive in the frost? Download Whiteout Survival now — a perfect survival experience blending teamwork, idle fun, and smart strategy!

description:
Conveyor’s ready, pigs are on standby. Tap to send a pig onto the conveyor so it rains balls onto pixel cubes of its own color. The number above its head is its ammo: that’s how many hits it makes. Run out and it leaves the stage; if not, it slips into one of the 5 waiting slots and, when you tap again, it jumps back on the conveyor to fire another round.
The conveyor has a capacity—push past the limit and you’ll need to wait. Send them in the right order, manage the flow, and hit the cubes to clear the board piece by piece. Simple mechanic, sticky loop: tap → flow → repeat.
Highlights
One-tap control: Quick sessions, easy one-handed play.
Color matching: Pigs only hit their own color—no target-picking hassle.
Conveyor capacity: Timing and queue management add a bite-size strategy layer.
5 waiting slots: Stack, sort, and launch at the perfect moment.
Short but “one more round” feel: Perfect for micro-breaks.
Satisfying pixel cleanup: Every hit leaves the board feeling crisp.
For anyone who loves fast action-puzzles, timing, and flow management. The pigs are ready. The cubes… not so much.

title: Kingshot
description:
Kingshot is an innovative idle medieval survival game that combines strategic gameplay with rich details waiting to be explored.

When a sudden rebellion overturns the fate of an entire dynasty and ignites a devastating war, countless people lose their homes. In a world riddled with societal collapse, rebel invasions, rampant disease, and mobs desperate for resources, survival is the ultimate challenge. As a governor in these turbulent times, it's up to you to lead your people through these adversities, devising internal and diplomatic strategies to rekindle the spark of civilization.

[Core Features]

Defend Against Invasions
Stay vigilant and ready to repel invasions at any moment. Your town, the last bastion of hope, depends on it. Gather resources, upgrade your defenses, and prepare for battle to ensure survival in these tough times.

Manage Human Resources
Enjoy a unique gameplay mechanic involving the allocation of survivor roles such as workers, hunters, and chefs. Monitor their health and happiness to ensure they remain productive. Respond quickly to illness to make sure everyone receives timely treatment.

Establish Laws
Codes of law are vital for sustaining civilization and are crucial for the growth and strength of your town.

[Strategic Gameplay]

Resource Struggle
Amidst the sudden state collapse, the continent is flooded with untapped resources. Refugees, rebels, and power-hungry governors are all eyeing these precious materials. Ready yourself for battle and use every strategy at your disposal to secure these resources!

Battle for Power
Compete against other players for the ultimate honor of becoming the strongest governor in this grand strategy game. Claim the throne and reign supreme!

Forge Alliances
Ease the burden of survival in this chaotic world by forming or joining alliances. Collaborate with allies to rebuild civilization!

Recruit Heroes
The game features a roster of unique heroes, each waiting to be recruited. Bringing together heroes with various talents and skills is essential for taking the initiative and ensuring safety in these desperate times.

Compete with Other Governors
Hone your heroes' skills, assemble your squads, and challenge other governors. Victory not only earns you valuable points, but also grants access to rare items. Lead your town to the top of the rankings and showcase the rise of a great civilization.

Advance Technology
With the rebellion obliterating almost all technological advancements, it's crucial to start rebuilding and reclaiming the fragments of lost tech. The race to master cutting-edge technology could determine the dominator of this new world order!

title: Triumph Arcade
description:
Play Games. Win Cash. Challenge Real Players.

Dive into 18+ exciting skill-based games—no ads, no distractions, just pure competition.

Win Real Money.

Over $400,000,000 paid out to players in the last year alone! Cash out instantly via Venmo, Debit, PayPal, or ACH.
(Must be 18+ to play for cash prizes.)


TOURNAMENTS

Live Multiplayer - Arena style battle against multiple real-time opponents.


1v1 Mode – Go head-to-head. Winner takes the pot.

Blitz Mode – Every point earns you instant cash. The faster you score, the more you win.  Streak Mode - Beat all point targets to get a massive payout

Limited-Time Challenges – High-stakes events with massive prize pools.


LEAGUES

Climb the ranks in competitive leagues by collecting crowns! The higher your league, the bigger the cash prizes. Each match is skill-based and fair, so everyone has an equal shot at winning. Will you make it to the top? 


Boosts

Unlock exclusive deposit offers, prize boosts, and stack up bonus cash for even larger tournament entries.
Invite your friends and get free bonus cash to boost your balance.


SUPPORT:

Access live chat support directly in the app anytime! Remember to have enough battery and time to complete your game.

List of games included:

Chicken Run - Cross the road and avoid cars, busses, and other obstacles. 
Chaos Cannon – Blast asteroids and survive the chaos in this space shooter. 
Golf – Sink putts, chip close, and shoot your lowest score possible. 
Pop Shot – Test your timing and accuracy in this fast-paced basketball challenge. 
Galaxy Gunner – Blast enemy ships and survive waves of interstellar combat. 
Snake Royale – Grow your snake, collect food, and avoid deadly collisions. 
Obby – Jump, dodge, and parkour your way through challenging obstacle courses. 
Word Link – Connect letters to form words and clear the board. 
Color Smash – Match colors quickly and keep the combo alive. 
Drive – Navigate traffic, avoid crashes, and see how far you can go. 
Touchdown Hero – Dodge defenders and race to the end zone for a touchdown. 
Ball Bounce - Jump between two spike filled walls and get as many bounces as you can. 
Peg Master – Fire balls at pegs and rack up points in this satisfying skill shot game. 
Super Peg Master - Drop plinko balls and hit the highest multiplier possible. 
Block Party – A timeless block-stacking puzzle game inspired by the classic Tetris. 
Pool - Line up your shot and sink the ball. Classic top down pool. 
Brick Breaker – Smash your way through layers of bricks. 
Shapes – Match and merge shapes to survive. 
Solitaire – The iconic solo card game, just as you remember it. 
Bear Blaster – Take aim in this fast-paced, first-person hunting challenge. 
Bingo – Daub the right tiles fast to win in this high-speed game of reflex! 
21 Blackjack – Stack cards to make 21 again and again. How long can you keep the streak alive?

HAVE FUN!

title: Jelly Busters: Puzzle Game
description:
Drop into the smoothest skatepark in town with the Jelly Busters crew, a squad of bouncy jellies who live to skate, color shoot, and bust their way through walls of cubes. Every run starts with a simple push on your board, a quick aim, and a clean shot as you send your jelly flying into a glowing, colorful puzzle blast of cubes hiding a secret picture and image below.

Jelly Busters adds a fun, skate-infused twist packed with ASMR pleasure and arcade-style thrills. With every tap, you shoot into stacks of colors, bust the cubes, and slowly keep busting the image underneath until the whole board is clear.

The sound and feel are tuned for maximum satisfying chill. Cubes crumble with soft pops, jellies bounce just right, and the whole game wraps you in a relaxing mood that still demands fast reaction and strategic thinking. title: Jewel Coloring
description:
Jewel Coloring: Sparkle & Create with Pixel Art Puzzles
Enter a vibrant world of glowing jewels where creativity and puzzle-solving come together in perfect harmony! Designed for easy, relaxing fun, this one-of-a-kind experience combines color sorting, pixel art creation, and satisfying casual gameplay all in one. With smooth, user-friendly controls and levels that gently grow more engaging, it’s the perfect way to unwind while keeping your mind active.
How to Play: Color, Sort, & Craft Beautiful Pixel Art
- Sort Jewels by Color with Ease: Just tap and arrange sparkling jewels into their matching color groups. No confusing rules or complicated steps—just simple, enjoyable sorting action.
- Plan & Organize Your Workspace: Keep your jewel shelf neatly arranged and think ahead to clear each puzzle efficiently. Every small choice helps you complete the picture smoothly.
- Uncover Stunning Pixel Art Masterpieces: As you sort and place each jewel, watch as hidden pixel art designs slowly come to life. Every level reveals a brand-new, dazzling image to enjoy.
- Enjoy Endless Creative Satisfaction: There’s no pressure—just calm, rewarding gameplay that turns every moment into a peaceful artistic break.
What Makes Jewel Coloring Special
- Hundreds of Unique Levels & Themes: Enjoy a huge variety of pixel art puzzles, with fresh themes and exclusive limited-time collections added regularly.
- Polished Visuals & Immersive Feedback: Bright, detailed 3D jewels, crisp visual effects, and satisfying audio feedback make every tap feel smooth and rewarding.
- Play Anywhere, No Wi-Fi Needed: Play offline whenever you have free time. Pause, resume, and play at your own speed, no internet connection required.
- Easy for Everyone, Fun for All Ages: Simple mechanics make it accessible for casual players, while thoughtful level design keeps it interesting for puzzle and art fans alike.
Why You’ll Love Jewel Coloring
- Gentle Brain Exercise: Sorting, planning, and matching help support focus, logic, and spatial thinking—all while having fun.
- Natural Stress Relief: Lose yourself in calming, rhythmic jewel sorting that helps you relax and unwind after a busy day.
- For All Skill Levels: Whether you’re looking for a quick distraction or a creative hobby, it’s made for kids, adults, and everyone in between.
Download Jewel Coloring today and step into a bright, peaceful world of color, jewels, and pixel art. Create, sort, and relax—your next artistic adventure is just a tap away!

description:
DMZ: Recon introduces a new tactical extraction experience in Call of Duty: Mobile, launching with Serpent Island, a brand-new map, and Building 21, a returning favorite from the original DMZ on PC and console. Players will complete contracts, outsmart hostiles and enemy squads, and extract their loot to grow stronger with each run. 

CALL OF DUTY® like never before—reimagined for mobile!

Jump into intense Multiplayer battles with classic modes like Team Deathmatch, Domination, and Kill Confirmed on legendary maps such as Shipment, Raid, and Standoff. Prefer Battle Royale? Squad up and conquer with dynamic modes like Tank Isolated and Training Ground, set in iconic battlegrounds.

Battle Royale chaos awaits! Explore all 5 POIs, fight to survive, and claim victory. Or, team up with friends for action-packed Multiplayer matches on fan-favorite maps like Nuketown.

Join millions of players and dominate the battlefield in CALL OF DUTY®: MOBILE—the ultimate free-to-play FPS experience. Whether it’s fast 5v5 team deathmatches, epic Zombies mode, or all-out Battle Royale warfare, the action never stops.

Lock and load—your next mission starts now!

DOWNLOAD FOR FREE TODAY
CALL OF DUTY®: MOBILE boasts console quality HD gaming on your phone with customizable and intuitive controls, voice and text chat with your friends, and thrilling 3D graphics and sound. Enjoy controller games? We got you! Experience this iconic FPS franchise, on the go. Play this FPS gun game anywhere.

NEW SEASONAL CONTENT UPDATED MONTHLY
CALL OF DUTY®: MOBILE has a variety of FPS game modes, maps, themed events, and rewards so it never gets old. Every season expands upon the story in the CALL OF DUTY® universe and brings new & unique unlockable content. Jump into battle royale today!

CUSTOMIZE YOUR UNIQUE LOADOUT
Unlock and earn dozens of iconic operators, weapons, outfits, score streaks, and new pieces of gear, allowing you to play CALL OF DUTY®: MOBILE your way.

COMPETITIVE AND SOCIAL PLAY
Fan of war multiplayer games? Gather your friends and test your mettle in competitive ranked mode or sharpen your aim in social play. Join a clan for a sense of community and earn unique rewards for participating in Clan Wars.

DOWNLOAD OPTIONS TO REDUCE APP SIZE
Download and play CALL OF DUTY®: MOBILE without the barrier of storage space. As part of an effort to make CALL OF DUTY®: MOBILE more accessible, the initial app download size has been reduced and additional options allow players to choose what is downloaded to experience the full game, such as HD resources, maps, weapons, and operators.

title: Amaze GO!
description:
Welcome to Amaze GO! A clean arrows puzzle game built to calm a busy mind. Every arrow points the way — what you need to do is to choose the right order. The design cuts visual noise, reduces chaos, and helps you organize thoughts as you play. Pick up an arrow. Find its lane. Repeat until the grid is yours. Enjoy the quiet flow offline anywhere and anytime.

What makes Amaze GO! great
1. Streamlined arrows puzzle that declutters the screen and the mind
2. Works offline with a clean interface that keeps attention on the board
3. Calm play loop for smart brains: think clearly, move each arrow with strategy
4. Smooth tap controls, clear path feedback, and satisfying release moments like ASMR

How to Play
- Find an arrow with a free path to the edge
- Tap to slide that arrow off the grid and open a lane for the next move
- Plan the order to secure a safe route and a clean board
- Long-Press to use Guidance to highlight directions when your path is unclear
- A wrong tap costs a heart for the level
- Clear the board to finish the level and aim for a perfect run
- Hints help focus when the grid feels tight

Why love this arrow puzzle
· Simple rules, profound strategy, and a meditative arrows puzzle
· Short breaks ease stress and sharpen focus
· The last arrow leaves the board with a satisfying mental reset
· Cognitive workout for sequencing and brain teasers
· Quiet visuals, plus a satisfying whoosh as each arrow flies off the grid — feedback that soothes instead of nags

Made for the in-between moments
- The ten minutes before a meeting starts 
- The metro ride too short for a podcast 
- The flight where your signal drops
- The wind-down after a noisy workday 

Amaze GO! - Puzzle Games is a quiet arrows puzzle made for sharp minds and calm moments. Learn fast, then master timing and order. Send every arrow off the board, untangle the grid, and feel disorder turn into clarity. Amaze GO! is the arrows puzzle you reach for when the rest of the day was too loud — one good move, then another, then a quiet board. Download now, plan smart paths, keep hearts safe, and enjoy pure focus anytime, anywhere!

title: Among Us!
description:
A game of teamwork and betrayal ...in space! Play online with 4-15 players as you attempt to prep your spaceship for departure, but beware as one or more random players among the Crew are Impostors bent on killing everyone.

MASTER YOUR SOCIAL DEDUCTION SKILLS.
Crewmates win by completing all tasks or discovering and voting the Impostors off the ship. The Impostor can use sabotage to cause chaos, making for easier kills and better alibis. Optional roles create a whole new level of gameplay. Try out the Scientist, Engineer, Guardian Angel, or Shapeshifter to create chaos! Think you’re a master of deception? Only one way to find out!

CUSTOMIZE YOUR GAME.
Choose how you want to play! Change the number of Impostors, roles, tasks, player visibility, and more. Play in style as you change your Crewmates’ color, visor, nameplate, outfit, and hat. More customization options are planned to be continually added in.

PLAY WITH ANYONE.
Cross-platform play is supported. Play with friends (or enemies?) between PC, mobile, or console!

If you have any issues, visit us at: https://www.innersloth.com/faq/

title: Castle Busters
description:
SMASH EVERY CASTLE. RULE EVERY ARENA.
Castle Busters is fast, loud, and unfair in the best way. Every brick breaks. Every shot counts. Draft 8 units, load your keep, and turn your rival's castle into a pile of rubble before they do it to you first. No grinding waves of bots. No 20-minute matches. Just real-time 1v1 PvP where one good angle wins the war.

DESTROY THE WALLS, NOT THE CLOCK
Matches are quick. Decisions are not. Pick your shot, read the enemy line, and fire. Every wall, tower and turret is destructible, so the map is never the same twice. Collapse a floor under an archer. Carve your own path, literally.

DRAFT YOUR SQUAD
Wrecker, Napalmer, Bomber, Scout, Fairy, Crow... Pick any 8. Each unit changes how you play, what angles you attack, and how you defend. Some builds are patient. Some are chaos. None of them are wrong if they win.

FORTIFY THE KEEP
Your castle is your army's home, shield, and weapon. Reinforce the walls that matter. Leave decoys. Bait your rival into breaking through somewhere they shouldn't. Defense isn't passive here, it's a trap.

THE FORGE
Upgrade your units. Strengthen your keep. Unlock new arenas with new hazards, new obstacles, new ways to break things. The deeper you go, the meaner the meta gets.

CLIMB THE LADDER
Climb your away towards Clash Colosseum. Arena by arena. Seasonal leaderboards. Rank matches against players who want your crown as badly as you want theirs. Only one castle stays standing. Sharpen your aim. Stack your squad. Crack their keep. The arena is open. Go break something.

Castle Busters is free to download and play. Some items are available for purchase with real money. A network connection is required. You must be at least 13 years old to play.

title: Food Hunt: Pixel Puzzle
description:
Every level is a pixel art masterpiece. Your ants will devour it - one color at a time.

Food Hunt is a satisfying color sort puzzle where the puzzle board IS the art. Each level presents a hand-crafted pixel art image built entirely from colored blocks. Sort your ants by color, send them in, and watch them eat the picture clean - block by block, until the board is empty and the level is cleared.

HOW TO PLAY
The board is filled with a pixel art image - built entirely from colored blocks. Below the board: your holding slots and block stacks waiting to be tapped.

Tap a block stack to load your ants. They march up and devour every matching colored block in the image. Clear all colors - wipe the board completely - and you win.

But choose your order carefully:

- Holding slots are limited - wrong tap order fills them fast
- Stuck slots = ants can't move = game over
- Plan which color to clear first
- Eat every last block - board empty - level clear!

THE PIXEL ART IS THE PUZZLE
Forget collecting rewards after you win. In Food Hunt, the pixel art image is the challenge itself.

Every level is a different image, built from hundreds of colored blocks. Watch your ants devour it layer by layer, color by color, until nothing remains.

You don't unlock the art. You clear it. And that's exactly what makes it satisfying.

FEATURES
-  200+ color sort puzzle levels -  new images, new challenges
-  Cute ants with ASMR-quality chomping animations
-  Simple one-tap controls - play with one hand
-  No timer, no pressure - relax at your own pace
- Levels designed to surprise - no two boards look the same
- 2× speed mode for snappier ant action

EASY TO LEARN. HARD TO STOP.
Early levels are breezy. Later levels pack in more colors, tighter slots, and bigger images that demand real planning.

Which color do you clear first? When do you free a slot before it jams? Every tap matters.

A true logic brain teaser - wrapped in pixel art you'll actually enjoy destroying.

WHY YOU CHOOSE FOOD HUNT?
Most color sort games show you an empty grid and ask you to fill it. Food Hunt flips it - every board starts full, alive with pixel art, and your only goal is to wipe it clean.
Same satisfying sort. A completely different feeling. 

Download Food Hunt - the color sort puzzle where the art is the game.

Take the Shot, Win the War.

Fight on the front line as an elite sniper while commanding the battle on a larger scale. Experience a seamless blend of intense tactical shooting and real-time strategy.

One Shot to Turn the Tide
• High-Stakes Sniping: Eliminate key targets to break through enemy defenses. One perfect shot can shift the momentum of an entire battle.
• Heavy Ordnance: Master more than just sniper rifles. Command machine guns, rocket launchers, and even tanks to blast your way to victory.
• Immersive Gunplay: Fluid controls and visceral slow-mo kill cams. Feel the recoil and impact of every trigger pull.

Take Back the City
• Urban Combat: Take on intense shooter missions. Clear out hostiles block by block and reclaim occupied districts.
• Secure Your Base: Restore captured facilities to establish your foothold, turning tactical victories into the foundation of a military empire.
• Rise to Command: What starts as a solo infiltration turns into a massive strike. That first shot is only the beginning of your rise to ultimate command.

Assemble Your Elite Force
• Draft Your Roster: Build a squad of specialized operatives. From seasoned combat vets to covert agents, put together a team that fits your playstyle.
• Combined Arms: Deploy fighter jets, main battle tanks, and drones to gain the upper hand across the battlefield.
• Forge an Elite Army: Train your soldiers, upgrade your officers, and unleash devastating tactical synergies on anyone standing in your way. 

Command the Global Front
• Fortify Your Stronghold: Expand your base, research cutting-edge tech, and prepare your forces for all-out global conflict.
• Forge Powerful Alliances: Team up with players across the globe. Coordinate massive strikes, share resources, and crush any force that opposes you.
• Tactical Supremacy: Push the frontlines, outsmart your rivals, and carve your name into history as a true legend.

title: Tiles Survive!
description:
Enter the world of "Tiles Survive!" and guide your team of survivors through a harsh wilderness. As the core of your survivor team, explore the wild, gather key resources, and use them wisely to strengthen your shelter.
Venture into different tiles and expand your territory. Improve how you manage resources, build and upgrade structures, and connect electricity to speed up production. Create a self-sufficient shelter where every decision shapes your survivors’ future.

Game Features:

● Operations & Management
Enhance your production structures for smoother workflows. Use electricity to run your shelter more efficiently. Unlock and upgrade more structures to meet your growing needs.

● Assign Survivors
Assign jobs to your survivors, like hunters, chefs, or lumberjacks. Pay attention to their health and morale to keep productivity high.

● Resource Collection
Explore further and discover unique resources in different biomes. Gather and use every resource to your advantage.

● Multi-map & Collectibles
Travel through multiple maps to find loot and special items. Bring them back to decorate and improve your shelter.

● Recruit Heroes
Find heroes with special skills and traits who boost your shelter’s capabilities.

● Form Alliances
Team up with friends to stand against common threats, such as severe weather and wild creatures.

In "Tiles Survive!", every choice matters. How you manage resources, plan your shelter, and explore the unknown will decide your fate. Are you ready to face the challenge and thrive in the wild? Download now and begin your epic adventure!

- VS Attack
- Club Challenge

COMPETE WITH FRIENDS

AUTHENTIC SOCCER / FOOTBALL GAMEPLAY

Play with over 19,000 real soccer superstar players from 690 teams across 35 leagues, including the UEFA Champions League, Premier League, LALIGA EA SPORTS, Bundesliga, Serie A, and Ligue 1 from the 2026 season. 

LIVE EVENTS AND REWARDS
Complete daily training and quests to earn rewards
- Play live events to earn & upgrade players. 
- Improve your soccer team throughout the 2026 season.
- Enjoy arcade-style mini games & football trivia for more rewards  

Build your soccer / football Ultimate Team, compete in online PvP, and play your way in EA SPORTS FC™ Mobile.

Word Games are a great way to expand your vocabulary and language skills. For the serious strategists and thinkers out there, our Mind Benders section is perfect. Chess and Chess puzzles will provide a mental workout and fun brain training. Hone your strategic skills, and take on the challenge to become the grandmaster.

Ever wanted to try your hand at an exotic game? Now you can, right from your device, with Mancala in our Exotic Games section.

'Offline Games' is a fantastic app for all ages - kids, teens, adults, and even seniors. It offers a fun, engaging, and stimulating gaming experience without the need for an internet connection. Whether you're on a long journey, stuck at home, or in the middle of a flight, you're never far from the action with 'Offline Games'. It's the perfect app to challenge yourself, pass the time, and have loads of fun.

Remember, with 'Offline Games', you don't need an internet connection to play. You can enjoy your favorite games anytime, anywhere. Say goodbye to those dull moments and welcome endless entertainment with 'Offline Games'. Who knew having fun could be this easy? Jump in and start playing today!

title: Dark War:Survival
description:
Gear up and brace yourself for the ultimate test of zombie apocalypse survival! Dive into thrilling gameplay and uncover captivating events that await your exploration!

As a sudden and catastrophic zombie virus ravages human society, your once cozy life is shattered. Family and friends turn into the walking dead before your very eyes. Escaping the chaos of your crumbling home, you now face the ultimate challenge: setting up a shelter to survive the zombie apocalyptic world, and reigniting the flames of human civilization. 

Can you successfully adapt to the hostile environment teeming with dangers, and lead your fellow survivors in rebuilding civilization? It's time for you to step up!

UNIQUE FEATURES

Assign Jobs
Assign your survivors to specialized work to maximize your shelter's growth. Don't forget to keep an eye on their health and happiness to ensure their productivity!

STRATEGIC MECHANICS

Gather & Explore
Venture into the desolate wastelands in search of valuable resources and rare items. Uncover hidden treasures and unlock new territories where dangers also lurk around every corner. 

Build & Expand 
Construct a sturdy shelter and fortify it against the ever-evolving zombie threats. Upgrade your defenses, unlock powerful weapons, and establish a safe haven for fellow survivors.

Recruit & Research
As the leader, you must assemble a diverse team of survivors with unique skills and abilities. Train them and equip them with powerful weapons and technologies to maximize their potential in battles against the undead.

Ally & Conquer
Join forces with other survivors to create a legendary alliance. Work together to conquer difficult challenges, win epic battles, and strategize to reclaim the world from the clutches of the undead.

Do you have what it takes to survive and thrive in the zombie apocalypse? Download the game and dive in now!

description:
Dream of becoming a Star Chef? Now’s your chance!
Ever imagined learning the secrets to perfect macarons in a Parisian kitchen under a Michelin-starred chef?
Welcome to Foodstars – the ultimate cooking adventure where global flavors meet culinary creativity!

► Merge Ingredients & Discover Secret Recipes
From recreating Italian classics with tomatoes and basil, to savoring refined French flair with gin and lemons, and even to experiencing the authentic taste of Germany with sausages and bread rolls, you can merge ingredients and unlock hundreds of mouthwatering recipes from around the world.

► Design Dream Restaurants Across the Globe
Renovate unique restaurants, from a roadside diner in New York to a traditional Kaiseki eatery in Tokyo, from Marseille’s bustling seafood bistro to a cozy coconut curry spot in Thailand. Complete orders and renovation tasks to rise to culinary fame!

title: Mob Control
description:
Lead, Multiply, and Conquer! Mob Control delivers thrilling tower defense action where you grow your mob, deploy powerful Champions, and crush enemy bases. Unlock collectible cards, conquer exciting modes, and climb the Champions League. Rise to tower defense supremacy!

Unleash Your Inner Commander in Mob Control: The Ultimate Tower Defense Clash!

Defend, Conquer, and Rise to Victory in this Epic Tower Defense Showdown!

Ready to become the ultimate tower defense champion? Test your skills, wit, and tactical prowess!

ODDLY SATISFYING GAMEPLAY: CREATE, GROW, AND LEAD!
- Experience the strangely satisfying thrill of watching your mob multiply as you aim and shoot at the gates. Witness your army grow to massive proportions!
- Strategically deploy your mighty Champions to break through enemy mobs and reach their bases. Choose the best combo for victory!
- Explore intriguing level elements like speed boosts, multipliers, moving gates, and more.

BECOME AN IMMORTAL PLAYER: RISE THROUGH THE RANKS!

Earn Championship Stars by winning battles, fortifying your bases, and dominating tournaments. Climb the prestigious Champions League using your Championship Stars and join the elite few who have conquered this tower defense realm.

FORTIFY YOUR BASE: SHIELD YOUR DOMINION!

Secure your base from enemy raids by winning battles and earning valuable shields. Protect your resources and maintain your tower defense dominance.

UNLOCK AND UPGRADE CARDS: COLLECT, EVOLVE, AND DOMINATE!

Win battles to unlock booster packs of varying rarities and enhance your card collection. Unlock all the Cannons, Mobs and Champions in the armory and discover their amazing evolutions as you level them up.

DIVERSE GAME MODES: CHALLENGE AND CONQUER!
- Base Invasion: Raid enemy strongholds, pilfer coins, and claim bricks from rival players.
- Revenge and Counter-Attack: Turn the tables on attackers and seek retribution against those who challenge your might.
- Boss Levels: Test your mettle in unique level layouts, earning extra bonuses as you conquer the toughest adversaries.

SEASON PASS: A CONSTANT STREAM OF FRESH CONTENT!

Dive into ever-evolving content with our monthly Season Pass. Complete quests, advance tiers, and unlock new heroes, Cannons and skins.

ALWAYS IMPROVING: JOIN THE EVOLUTION!

Our dedicated team delivers fresh mechanics and content every month. Share your ideas via Settings > Discord and contribute to the evolution of Mob Control.

A PREMIUM EXPERIENCE: YOUR CHOICE TO PLAY AD-FREE!

Mob Control is free to download and utilizes ads to support ongoing development. Opt for the Premium Pass or a permanent no-ads package to enjoy uninterrupted tower defense action. Skip'Its speed up your progress and give you extra rewards without watching ads.

Join the tower defense clash! Rally your army, collect powerful cards, and become the champion you were born to be.

SUBSCRIPTION DETAILS
- This app may offer monthly subscriptions.
- Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
- Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase.
- Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period.
- You can cancel your subscription at any time, but you will not get a refund for any remaining period of a subscription.

Support: Your Satisfaction Matters! Connect with us in-game via Settings > Help and Support whenever you need assistance.

Your privacy is crucial to us. Review our comprehensive privacy policy at https://www.voodoo.io/privacy

Relax and Have Fun! Leave your worries behind and enjoy quality relaxation and fun. Immerse yourself in the soothing game atmosphere , enjoy your brain time and increase your zen!

Become the Master of 3D Puzzles! Time is of the essence in this match 3d game! With each level equipped with a timer, you’ll need to think fast and act even faster to triumph!

Boosters to the Rescue! Stuck on a level? Fear not! Match Factory offers a range of powerful boosters to help you overcome tricky situations. Utilize these remarkable tools to advance through the game and unlock exciting items like fruits, candy, cake objects and much more!

Immerse yourself in the world of Match Factory, where thrilling 3D puzzles and hidden objects awaits your keen eye and sharp mind! Download Match Factory now and prove your matching skills to the world! Can you conquer every level and emerge as the ultimate puzzle master?

* Charming ant colony gameplay
* Tiny worker ants carrying colorful cubes
* Relaxing color sorting puzzles
* Unlock beautiful pixel art
* Simple one-tap controls
* Fun and challenging brain teasers
* No timer, no pressure
* Play offline anytime, anywhere
* From easy levels to tricky colony missions

Command the colony, sort the cubes, clear the trail, and complete beautiful pixel art in Colony Flow!

title: Angry Birds 2
description:
Play the world's best bird flinging, pig popping game!

Use the slingshot to fling birds at the piggies' towers and bring them crashing down – all to save the precious eggs.

New to the world of Angry Birds? Angry Birds 2 is the best way to get to know all of the iconic characters and experience the fun gameplay that has captured the hearts (and spare time) of millions of players.

Decorated Angry Birds veteran? Everything you love about classic Angry Birds games is here with some awesome new additions. Choose which bird to fling when, play with friends, take on multi stage levels, and compete and collaborate with players around the globe.

Features:
● CHOOSE YOUR BIRD. Choose which bird to put in the slingshot and defeat the pigs with strategy!  
● MULTI-STAGE LEVELS. Play fun, challenging levels with multiple stages – just watch out for those Boss Pigs!  
● DAILY CHALLENGES. Have a minute? Complete a daily challenge and earn some quick rewards.  
● LEVEL UP your birds with feathers and up their scoring power. Build the ultimate flock!   
● JOIN A CLAN to take down the pigs with friends and players around the world.  
● IMPRESS THE MIGHTY EAGLE in Mighty Eagle's Bootcamp and earn coins to use in his exclusive shop.  
● COMPETE in the ARENA. Compete with other players for some friendly bird flinging fun and prove who is the best.  
● COLLECT SILLY HATS. Collect hats with different fun themes and level up your birds' fashion game.  
● BAD PIGGIES. The green baddies are back, stronger, badder, and even greener.  
● LOTS OF LEVELS. Play hundreds of levels with more added in regular updates and limited time events.  
● LEADERBOARDS. Prove who is the best in the world on the global leaderboards.  
● FREE to download!    

---

This game may require internet connectivity and subsequent data transfer charges may apply. When the game is played for the first time, there is a one-off download of additional content.

title: Toon Blast
description:
Welcome to “Toon Blast,” a free match-3 adventure that combines fun and strategy. Join Bruno Bear, Cooper Cat, and Wally Wolf in blasting cubes and solving puzzles without Wi-Fi. This calming game is packed with addictive mini-games and challenges. Each level is a unique puzzle experience, offering a blend of fun and strategic gameplay. Immerse yourself in this captivating world, enjoy relaxing puzzle-solving, and embark on an unforgettable adventure. “Toon Blast” is more than a game; it’s a journey of joy and relaxation, free for all to enjoy.

In “Toon Blast,” you’ll find a lot of levels and new episodes. Each level has different goals and fun obstacles. Use special boosters to move up levels, and earn stars for rewards. Make a team, compete, and stay in the game with help from teammates. The game is easy to start but gets challenging, and you can play it on your phone or tablet.

title: 2 Player Games : Offline Games
description:
If you want to play with your friend on the same device, this is the right game!
But also if you have no friends to have fun in multiplayer on one device, just play alone against the AI!
Challenge your friend with this collection of 2 player games and enjoy the beautiful graphics of the minigames!

Choose between one of the 2 player games ( and remember that you can also play alone against the AI if you have no possibility to multiplayer):

Ping Pong :
Move the racket with your finger and challenge your friends!

Spinner war :
Push your opponent outside the stage! Two players on a small area are too much!

Air hockey :
Use your finger to move the paddle and score letting the puck entering in your friend's goal!

Snakes :
Don't touch your opponent's body and stay alive!

Pool :
The classic pool game for 2 player on one device!
 
Tic tac toe :
Instead of using pen and paper just open the app and challenge your friend on the same device! A two player classic!

Penalty kicks :
Let the goalkeeper dive and kick the soccer ball to make goal! 

Sumo :
The multiplayer version of a famous Japanese sport!

And much more! (Like minigolf, racing cars, sword duels, chess...)

This collection of 2 player games features beautiful minimal graphics to keep your focused on the duel with your opponent and it saves scores between matches, this way you can dispute a 2 player cup and let the challenge go on between minigames!
Unleash the power of local multiplayer on one device / one phone / one tablet, and bring the fun to the party!
Disclaimer: this multiplayer game can ruin friendships!

title: Brawl Stars
description:
Fast paced 3v3 & 5v5 MOBA and Battle Royale made for mobile! Play online with friends or solo across a variety of PvP arena game modes in under three minutes.


Unlock and upgrade dozens of Brawlers with powerful super abilities, star powers and gadgets! Collect unique skins to stand out and show off. Battle in a variety of mysterious arena locations within the MOBA Brawliverse!

Brawl Stars is free to download and play, however, some game items can also be purchased for real money (including random items). If you don't want to purchase game items for real money, please disable in-app purchases in your device's settings.


◉ BATTLE IN MULTIPLE GAME MODES:


▶ Gem Grab (3v3,5v5): Team up for real time 3v3 and 5v5 MOBA arena PvP battles against online players from across the world. Team up to battle and out strategize the opposing team. Collect and hold 10 gems to win, but get fragged and lose your gems.


▶ Showdown (solo/duo): A MOBA battle royale style fight for survival. Collect power ups for your Brawler. Grab a friend or play solo, be the last Brawler standing in the rowdiest MOBA PvP battle royale yet. Winner takes it all! 


▶ Brawl Ball (3v3,5v5): It's a whole new brawl game! Show off your soccer/football skills and score two goals before the other team. There are no red cards here.


▶ Bounty (3v3,5v5): Battle to take out opponents and earn stars, but don’t let them pick you off. The squad with the most stars wins the match!


▶ Heist (3v3,5v5): Protect your team’s safety and try to crack open your opponents’. Navigate the arena to sneak, blast, battle and blow your way clear to the enemies treasure.


▶ Special MOBA Events: Limited time special MOBA PvE and PvP arena battle game modes.


▶ Championship Challenge: Join Brawl Stars' esports scene with in-game qualifiers!




◉ UNLOCK AND UPGRADE BRAWLERS:


Collect and upgrade a variety of Brawlers with powerful super abilities, star powers and gadgets! Level them up and collect unique skin.
A fast paced battle royale MOBA made for mobile. Unlock and collect new, powerful "brawlers", each with a signature attack and super ability.



◉ BRAWL PASS:


Complete quests, open Brawl Boxes, earn Gems, pins and an exclusive Brawl Pass skin! Fresh content every season.



◉ BECOME THE STAR PLAYERS


Battle to climb the local and regional PvP leaderboards to prove you’re the greatest MOBA brawler of them all! Join or start your own MOBA club with fellow players online to share tips and battle together. Climb to the top of the PvP leaderboards in global and local rankings.




◉ CONSTANTLY EVOLVING MOBA


Look out for new "brawlers", skins, maps, special events and game modes in the future. Customize Brawlers with unlockable skins. Enjoy PVP battles solo or with friends online.
New PVP and PVE events and game modes daily. Player designed maps offer challenging new terrain to master.


From the makers of “Clash of Clans”, “Clash Royale” and “Boom Beach”!

• Dress up your virtual models with an extensive wardrobe collection filled with glam outfits.

title: Family Farm Merge
description:
Family Farm Merge: Merge Your Way Back to Nature!

Welcome to Family Farm Merge, a brand-new merge game in the beloved Family Farm series. Here, the warmth of classic farm life meets relaxing, satisfying merge gameplay. You will do more than manage a farm. You will help bring color and life back to an entire valley.
Tired of the noise and rush of the city, Ella returns to Breeze Valley, a place she remembers from her childhood. But the farm she finds is no longer the one she knew. The windmill has stopped turning, the flowers have lost their color, and the land seems to have fallen into a deep sleep. Then Ella discovers a mysterious golden hourglass, and an old promise between people and nature begins to awaken...
Now, it is your turn to wake the valley.

Merge and Rebuild
- Drag and merge to unlock hundreds of crops, flowers, and farm items.
- Start with a faded, forgotten farm and restore it into a bright, lively paradise.
- Keep merging to discover hidden resources and miraculous tools.

Classic Farm Life, Fresh New Fun
- Enjoy the familiar charm of Family Farm in a fresh new way.
- Raise animals, harvest crops, make goods, and enjoy the simple pleasures of country life.
- Merge gameplay makes farming easier, smoother, and more relaxing than ever.

Discover the Story of Breeze Valley
- Follow Ella as she uncovers the secret of the Golden Covenant.
- Meet villagers full of personality and help restore the bond between people and nature.
- Every piece of land and every chapter of the story holds a little warmth waiting to be rediscovered.

Relax, Connect, and Share the Fun
- Team up with friends and bring your farm back to life faster.
- Join events to earn limited decorations and rare resources.
- Build a farm that is truly your own and show off your unique style.

In Family Farm Merge, you are not just merging crops and items. You are restoring a long-lost connection between people and nature.
Start your journey now and help Breeze Valley bloom again!

title: Goods Puzzle: Sort Challenge
description:
Get ready to embark on an exciting matching adventure like never before in Goods Sorting: Match 3 Puzzle! This Pair matching puzzle game offers a unique twist on the classic match 3 genre, combining strategic sorting, and rearranged challenges with thrilling puzzle gameplay.

FEATURES:
- Challenging Sorting Gameplay: Dive into a world of goods and engage in addictive sorting puzzles. Swap and match 3 or more identical goods to clear them from the board & earn points.
- Unique Goods and Abilities: Encounter a wide variety of goods with different properties & special abilities. Some goods may explode, while others can clear entire rows or columns. - Strategize your moves to make the most of these abilities and create powerful combos.
- Exciting Power-Ups and Boosters: Unlock & use a range of power-ups & boosters to enhance your sorting abilities. These useful tools can help you overcome obstacles, clear difficult levels & achieve high scores.
- Engaging Levels & Stories: Explore different stories on this 3D sorting adventure, each with its own set of challenging levels. From bustling marketplaces to serene gardens, the visually stunning environments will keep you captivated.
- Obstacles and Limited Moves: Face various obstacles and limited moves as you progress through the game. Plan your moves carefully and strategize to overcome these challenges and complete objectives within the given limit.

HOW TO PLAY:
- Swap & rearrange adjacent goods to create matches of 3.
- Match 3 goods to create powerful combos & earn bonus points.
- Utilize the special abilities of certain goods to your advantage.
- Use power-ups and boosters strategically to overcome obstacles & clear levels.
- Achieve high scores & complete objectives to progress through the game & unlock new levels & stories.

Embark on this sorting adventure & challenge yourself with the unique gameplay of Goods Sorting: Pair Matching Puzzle. Get ready to sort, match, rearrange & conquer the exciting puzzles that await you!

title: Stack Smash - 3D Puzzle Game
description:
Welcome to the farm’s biggest little smash festival!

Aim your cannon, line up the perfect shot, and smash through stacks of barrels, crates, jam jars, hay bales, fruit, veggies, and other farmyard goodies. Every cannon shot can send objects flying, trigger satisfying chain reactions, and bring the whole structure crashing down.

Each level is a playful physics puzzle where every shot matters. Look for the weak spot, choose the best angle, and shoot your way through clever stacks and tricky obstacles. Some levels can be cleared with one perfect smash, while others require careful aim, smart puzzle solving, and a few well-placed cannonballs.

Enjoy satisfying physics-based destruction as wood tumbles, jars shatter, barrels roll, and colorful farm objects bounce across the level. With simple shoot-and-smash controls, Stack Smash is easy to learn, relaxing to play, and full of fun physics puzzles to master.

Explore a cozy farm festival filled with barns, market stalls, balloons, and cute farmhand characters. Take on new levels, discover new things to smash, and keep the festival moving with every successful shot.

GAME FEATURES

- Fun aim, shoot, and smash cannon gameplay
- Satisfying physics-based destruction
- Clever puzzle levels with limited shots
- Colorful stacks, obstacles, and structures to knock down
- Fruit, vegetables, hay, jars, barrels, crates, and more to smash
- Cozy farm festival locations
- Cute and friendly farmhand characters
- Simple controls with rewarding precision shots
- Bright 3D visuals and playful animations
- Quick puzzle levels for playing anytime

The cannon is loaded, the targets are stacked, and the farm festival is ready.

Aim carefully, shoot the cannon, and smash your way through every level in Stack Smash!

title: XP Hero
description:
Are you ready to survive the chaos and become the ultimate hero? 

A mysterious world of monsters, darkness, and nonstop danger is waiting for you in XP Hero. Trapped in a deadly realm with no way back, your hero must fight, survive, and grow stronger through every battle, every challenge, and every new threat. Step into an action-packed rpg game where only the strongest can survive the endless danger ahead.

- Features 

▶ Face Powerful Enemies
Danger is everywhere, and every enemy is ready to attack. Enter intense battle stages filled with monsters, traps, and fast-moving threats. Your hero must fight through each wave, survive every challenge, and defeat every enemy to move forward. In this dark survival game, every battle matters.

▶ Unlock Powerful Weapons & Combat Styles
Arm your hero with powerful weapons and discover the best way to fight. From blades to firearms, every loadout changes the flow of battle and gives this action game a fresh feel. Use each skill at the right moment, adapt to different enemy patterns, and build a combat style that matches your strategy. The more you fight, the stronger your hero becomes.

▶ Explore a Mysterious World
Step into ruined lands, shadowy dungeons, and abandoned battlefields as you explore a dangerous fantasy world. Every area brings a fresh challenge, stronger enemy types, and more rewards for your hero. This rpg game gives you new places to explore, new ways to fight, and new dangers to survive.

▶ Challenge Massive Boss Fights
Every great hero must face a powerful boss. Prepare for massive boss fights filled with deadly attacks, intense battle moments, and high-risk survival action. Each boss battle is a true test of timing and power. Fight hard, survive every attack pattern, and defeat each boss to earn rewards and prove your hero can become a true legend.

▶ Upgrade Your Hero
Power up your hero with progression systems that let you build your strength over time. Upgrade weapons, improve abilities, unlock a new skill, and build the right setup for every challenge. A smart upgrade can change the outcome of a tough battle, help you fight longer, and make it easier to survive against stronger enemies.

▶ Fast-Paced Action Gameplay
This is more than a simple action game. XP Hero combines fast combat, rewarding progression, and endless excitement in one addictive game loop. Jump into every battle, fight to survive, and play through nonstop waves of danger. Every game delivers fresh action, intense battle moments, and more chances to fight your way forward.

Ready to play, fight, survive, explore, and upgrade through chaos?

Lead your hero across an endless world of danger, defeat every enemy, conquer every boss, and build your path to become a living legend in this action game.

If you have any issues or suggestions during gameplay, feel free to contact us at the email below.

title: Rap Star:Idle Clicker
description:
From streets to stardom — tap, rap, earn, date, collect. Rap Star: Idle Clicker is a rap life simulator meets idle tycoon. Start with $1 and build your rap empire. Every tap rewrites your destiny.
TAP TO RAP, STACK CASH Every tap is money. From freestyling on corners to sold-out stadiums, your rap career starts from zero. Invest in studios, unlock new flows, hire producers. Even offline, your hustle never stops.
FROM BROKE TO BILLIONAIRE A busted car with no AC and one dollar. That's all you start with. But the finish line is a penthouse, a private jet, and an island with your name on it. Upgrade your crib, car, clothes, studio — watch your world transform from ruins to empire. Not a fairy tale. A real, brick-by-brick come-up.
BUILD YOUR MUSIC EMPIRE More than making songs — build an empire. Own a record label, launch fashion lines, sign rising stars. Drop singles that break the internet, top the charts, become a cultural icon. Every choice shapes your legend.
MINI-GAMES THAT KEEP YOU HOOKED Your rap career isn't just tapping — addictive mini-games pop up throughout your rise. The faster your fingers, the faster your fame.
ROMANCE — STARS ARE NEVER ALONE When you reach the top, the women follow. They're not accessories — each one has her own story, her own temper, her own world. Take her somewhere romantic and watch her melt. Take her somewhere ridiculous and watch her flip. Give her a cheap little gift to make her smile, or drop serious cash on luxury and watch her scream. Get to know her past and enter her heart, or keep your distance and enjoy the tension. Every woman treats you differently. Every relationship goes where you take it. Loyal or player? Deep love or just a fling? This is your life. Nobody chooses for you.
COLLECT — DEFINE YOUR IDENTITY THROUGH TASTE Every rap legend has a collection. Kicks, vinyl, skateboards, diamond grillz — these aren't just items. They're symbols of rap culture. Symbols of who you are. Open the vault. Pull legendary pieces. Every item makes you stronger, and completing certain combos unlocks hidden stories — about the deepest secrets in the industry. Your collection isn't just trophies in a display case. It's proof of the roads you've walked, the money you've earned, the life you've lived.
IMMERSIVE STORY Comic-style dialogue with branching choices that affect the outcome. Every decision changes your path, your reputation, and your ending.
PK BATTLES PK battles in your hood. Upgrade faster to win. Defend your block. Earn respect.

- Drop coins, collect rewards, and build the ultimate Coin Collector machine.

title: OneState RP: Role Play Online
description:
OneState – Live Free, Play Real

In OneState, real players run everything — the streets, the businesses, the law. A mobile open-world roleplay set in modern LA, up to 900 of them per server, not NPCs. Find your people in the biggest Social RP community on mobile.

Live Your Role
Create your own story in a living city, explore our highly detailed pocket-sized copy of LA! Be whoever you want to be in that rp life simulator – gangster, police officer, serviceman, medic, CEO of your own business empire. Build your life from the ground up and make your mark in a massive role play open world that never sleeps.

Hustle - Trade - Profit
Start small, dream big. Work your job, flip deals, build your business, and invest in real estate. Rise from the streets to the skyline. In OneState ambition pays off – your hustle defines you. Wanna’ matter? Make a move! Live it all in roleplay online multiplayer, where every step counts.

Uphold the Law or Break It
Enforce the law as a police officer, dominate the urban battlefield as a soldier, or save lives as a medic. Not your role play style? Then live the thug life, join the gang game, conquer territories, and build your street empire. Every path matters. This is true city life role-play!

Drive Hard – Drive Custom
Own the streets with fully-tunable rides. Collect, upgrade, and design cars that scream personality. There’s no proper city roleplay without a proper car park, right? Cruise, drift, or escape high-speed police pursuits – every car race, every new tune-up adds to your fame. Your garage in OneState not just stores your cars, it also contains part of your online rp identity.

Create Your Image
Life roleplay is about being authentic and unique. Customize your look, and style. From your outfit and accessories to your attitude – everything tells your story. Develop your reputation, climb ranks, and live it your way in the ultimate RP mobile simulator.

Join a Living City
Seasonal events and fresh drops keep OneState a constantly evolving online roleplay world. Interact with real people in a massive RP community on mobile.

Create your story and live it out in OneState – the life simulator where freedom is real!

title: Clash of Clans
description:
Join millions of players worldwide as you build your village, raise a Clan, and compete in epic Clan Wars!
Mustachioed Barbarians, fire wielding Wizards, and other unique troops are waiting for you! Enter the world of Clash!

Clash of Clans is free to download and play, however, some game items can also be purchased for real money (including random items). If you don't want to purchase game items for real money, please disable in-app purchases in your device's settings.


Classic Features:
● Join a Clan of fellow players or start your own and invite friends.
● Assemble an army with countless combinations of spells, troops, and Heroes!
● Customize your village and build it into a mighty stronghold. 

Multiplayer:
● Fight in Clan Wars as a team against millions of active players across the globe. Test your skills in the competitive Clan War Leagues and prove you're the best.
● Forge alliances and work together with your Clan in Clan Games to earn valuable Magic items.
● Test your skills in Ranked Mode and take part in competitive battles with players from around the world. Prove you're the best and rise all the way to the top of  the Leaderboard in Legend League.
● Collect resources and plunder loot from other players to upgrade your village and turn it into a tough fortress.
● Defend against enemy attacks with a multitude of Towers, Cannons, Bombs, traps, Mortars, and walls.
●  Unlock epic Heroes like Barbarian King, Archer Queen, Grand Warden, Royal Champion, Minion Prince, Dragon Duke, and Battle Machine.
● Research upgrades in your Laboratory to make troops, spells, and Siege Machines even more powerful.
● Create your own custom PVP experiences through Friendly Challenges, Friendly Wars, and special events.
● Watch Clanmates attack and defend in real-time as a spectator or check out the video replays.

Single Player:
●   Fight against the Goblin King in a single player campaign mode and become a hero of the realm.
●  Learn new tactics and experiment with army combinations and Clan Castle troops in Practice Mode.

Builder Base:
● Journey to the mysterious shores of Builder Base and discover new buildings, characters, and a whole new way to play.
● Turn your Builder Base into an unbeatable fortress and defeat rival players in Versus Battles.
● Collect exclusive Hero Skins and Sceneries to customize your village.


What are you waiting for, Chief? Join the action today.

A network connection is also required.

Player Reviews: Clash of Clans proudly announces over eight million five star reviews on the App Store.

If you have fun playing Clash of Clans, you may also enjoy other Supercell games like Clash Royale, Brawl Stars, Boom Beach, and Hay Day. Make sure to check those out!
Support: Chief, are you having problems? Visit https://help.supercellsupport.com/clash-of-clans/en/index.html or contact us in game by going to Settings > Help and Support.

Privacy Policy: http://www.supercell.net/privacy-policy/

Terms of Service: http://www.supercell.net/terms-of-service/

Parent's Guide: http://www.supercell.net/parents

The IGRS Rating for this game is 15+

Notice of Access Permission:
[Optional permission]
Clash of Clans may request permission via in-game pop ups to access your camera and send you notifications.
Camera: For in-game scanning of QR codes
Notifications: For sending notifications related to the game
Consent is optional and you can use the app and play the game regardless of whether or not you consent. You may refuse to give consent within the game. However, certain app features may not work properly if you refuse optional access permissions.

title: Zen Word® - Relax Puzzle Game
description:
Playing Zen Word 10 minutes a day brings you incredible challenging and relaxing experiences.
 
Zen word is a challenging word game & brain game that helps to train your brain and sharpen your mind. Zen Word is much more challenging than most other word puzzle games. Unlike crossword puzzles games or word cross games or word scramble games, all words in Zen Word are uncrossed, without any logical connection that can give you hints to help you solve the puzzles.  In Zen Word, you need to search and connect the right letters to find 20 hidden words on average in each level to test your vocabulary. The length of the words is the only clue that will help you find all the words and solve the puzzles. Therefore, Zen Word has very high requirements for your vocabulary and spelling skills. All word puzzles in Zen Word are carefully designed and will definitely give you a completely different challenging experience. 

Also, Zen Word is very different from word-search games. In word search games, your objective is to find and mark all the words hidden inside the letters box. The arrangement of these words in word-search games has clear rules, even if you don't know the spelling of the words, you can still search and find all the hidden words to solve the puzzles. As you find more words, the difficulty of word search games gets easier. However in Zen Word, as you find more words, the difficulty of the game will increase sharply. The rest of the words are extremely hard for you to remember and to spell. In the process of recalling words, you can make your brain sharper. Zen word is a word game for adults to train their brains. 
 
In addition to bringing you a super challenging experience, Zen Word can also bring you the best relaxing and calm experience.In some crossword puzzles or some word search games or word finder games, you must find all words in limited time, giving you a lot of pressure. In Zen Word, there is no countdown, no competition or any other designs that make you anxious or interrupt your puzzle solving experience. You can fully immerse yourself in word puzzles, accompanied by beautiful and peaceful nature backgrounds and peaceful music. All the backgrounds and music are carefully selected in the style of zen. title: eFootball™
description:
■ "eFootball™" - An Evolution from "PES"
It's an all-new era of digital soccer: "PES" has now evolved into "eFootball™"! And now you can experience the next generation of soccer gaming with "eFootball™"!

■ Welcoming Newcomers
After downloading, you can learn the basic controls of the game via a step-by-step tutorial that includes practical demonstrations! Complete them all, and receive Lionel Messi!

We have also added the Smart Assist setting to help users enjoy the fun and excitement of playing matches.
Without entering complex commands, get past the opposing defense with a brilliant dribble or pass, then score a goal with a powerful shot.

[Ways of Playing]
■Start Off With Your Favorite Team
Whether it's a club or national side from Europe, the Americas, Asia, or elsewhere around the world, begin a new game with the team you support!

■ Sign Players
After creating your team, it's time to get some signings in! From current superstars to soccer legends, sign players and take your team to new heights!

■ Playing Matches
Once you have built a team with your favorite players, it's time to take them to the field.
From testing your skills against the AI, to competing for ranking in Online Matches, enjoy eFootball™ the way you like!

■ Player Development
Depending on Player Types, signed players can be further developed.
Level up players by putting them in matches or using in-game items, then spend the Progression Points acquired to increase Player Stats.

In case you prefer to customize a player to fit your personal preferences, you have the option to allocate the Progression Points manually.
When in doubt about how to develop the player, you can use the [Recommended] function to automatically allocate his Points.
Develop your players to your exact liking!

[For More Fun]
■ Weekly Live Updates
The Live Update is the feature that reflects player transfers and match achievements from soccer in real life.
Take note of the Live Updates released each week, adjust your squad, and make your mark out on the field.

■ Customize a Stadium
Choose your favorite Stadium Elements, such as Tifos and Giant Props, and watch them appear at your stadium during the matches you play.
Add color to the game by arranging your stadium however you like!

*Users with one of the following nations as their Country/Region of Residence will not have access to loot boxes that require eFootball™ Coins as payment.
Belgium, Brazil (users under 18 years of age)

[For the Latest News]
New features, modes, events, and gameplay improvements will be continuously implemented.
For more information, see the official eFootball™ website.

[Downloading the Game]
Approximately 3.2 GB of free storage space is required to download and install eFootball™.
Please make sure you have enough free space before beginning the download.
We also recommend that you use a Wi-Fi connection to download the base game and any of its updates.

[Online Connectivity]
An internet connection is required to play eFootball™. We also strongly recommend playing with a stable connection to ensure you get the most out of the game.
